pages.text: $(bold)Robe Lace$() is the dedicated part of the $(bold)Wizard Armor$() (the only entry in the $(l:tools)Tools$() category that is a part rather than a finished tool).$(br2)Its stat is $(bold)maille$() — it only carries the material's $(bold)armor traits$(), never any weapon trait.$(br2)Part cost: $(bold)2$(bold) materials$() (the same as Tinkers' own maille).

$(bold)Two ways to obtain it$() (exactly like every other part):$(li)$(bold)Part Builder$(): blank pattern + 2 materials$(li)$(bold)Casting$(): fluid melted from 2 materials + a cast (the cast is not consumed)$(br2)$(bold)The three casts$():$(li)$(bold)Gold cast$(): cast from 1 robe lace + 90 mB of molten gold at a Casting Table; reusable$(li)$(bold)Sand cast$(): made by casting a gold cast, or by pressing sand directly on the Part Builder$(li)$(bold)Red sand cast$(): same, with red sand$(br2)Sand and red sand casts are both $(bold)single use$().

$(bold)Grey base and material variants$(): the lace's item texture is a $(bold)greyscale base$() ($(italic)assets/tinkersnewlife/textures/item/tool/parts/robe_lace.png$(), 16×16) that Tinkers' $(bold)texture generator$() tints at runtime — so $(bold)every material gets its own colour$().$(br2)When no material colour is found it falls back to the grey $(*_tconstruct_unknown.png$() texture, so any material still displays properly.$(br2)$(bold)Use$(): assembled together with $(bold)plating + maille$() at the $(bold)Tinkers' Anvil$() into Wizard Armor (consuming one magic cloth as well).
